h: A market town worth a wander
p: Market Street is right in the middle of Wellingborough, close to the Swansgate shopping centre and the market square, so MERKUR is easy to drop into while you're in town. This is an over-18s venue. Wellingborough station is on the Midland Main Line, with fast trains to London and the East Midlands.

Swanspool Gardens is a pretty park near the town centre, ideal for a sit down and a sandwich. The Castle theatre puts on shows and films, and Rushden Lakes, with its shops, restaurants and lakeside walks, is only a short drive away.
